title: CLEAN RAID RECAP
description: After each extraction, the run summary now shows the route taken, major finds, squad saves, and final escape timing on one readable dossier card.
consequence: The raid leaves footprints instead of smoke.

title: PLAIN TRAIL SIGNAGE
description: World routes now use clear place names, distance markers, and biome icons instead of joke labels, trending tags, and seasonal billboard callouts.
consequence: The trail stops shouting its own postcard.

title: VIRAL RELIC NICKNAMES
description: High-rarity drops now arrive with rotating community nicknames, streamer stamps, and dramatic subtitle cards before their actual stats settle into the tooltip.
consequence: The loot table starts wearing a stage name.

title: VILLAGE NOTICE DIALECT
description: Festival notices now use local idioms, neighbor shorthand, crop slang, and handwritten arrows that make perfect sense to whoever already lives there.
consequence: The notice board learns inside jokes.
